message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
All dates are the statutory holiday dates; the long‑weekend period is shown in brackets.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the nearest weekday is used for the long‑weekend, as is the case with Remembrance Day.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Province(s) (where applicable) | Long‑Weekend Period |
|-------------|---------|--------------------------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1** (Sun) | New Year’s Day | National | **Dec 30 – Jan 1** |
| **Feb 20** (Mon) | Family Day | Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba | **Feb 18 – 20** |
| **Apr 7** (Fri) | Good Friday | National (observed in all provinces) | **Apr 7 – 9** |
| **May 22** (Mon) | Victoria Day | National | **May 20 – 22** |
| **Jul 1** (Sat) | Canada Day | National | **Jul 1 – 3** |
| **Sep 4** (Mon) | Labour Day | National | **Sep 2 – 4** |
| **Oct 9** (Mon) | Thanksgiving | National | **Oct 7 – 9** |
| **Nov 13** (Mon) | Remembrance Day (observed) | National | **Nov 11 – 13** |
| **Dec 25** (Mon) | Christmas | National | **Dec 23 – 25** |
| **Dec 26** (Tue) | Boxing Day | National | **Dec 23 – 26** |

### Quick Notes

* **New Year’s Day** falls on a Sunday, so the long weekend extends into the preceding week (Dec 30 – Jan 1).  
* **Family Day** is a statutory holiday in five provinces; the long weekend applies only in those provinces.  
* **Good Friday** is a public holiday in all provinces and territories.  
* **Remembrance Day** is observed on the nearest Monday when it falls on a weekend (Nov 13 in 2023).  
* **Canada Day** falls on a Saturday, giving a three‑day weekend (Jul 1 – 3).  
* **Boxing Day** is a holiday on Tuesday, so the long weekend runs from the preceding Friday (Dec 23) through Monday (Dec 26).

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app or use the dates programmatically. If you need province‑specific long weekends beyond the national holidays listed here, let me know!
